extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, who prioritized the lowest premium. The agent scheduled a plan review for 4 days later.
composition.coaching_note: Tamika asked the customer to sign the Scope of Appointment while on the line, but it would be better to have the customer sign it before discussing benefits. This would ensure compliance with the waiting period rule.
